nodes.description: Public mapping recording token balances of addresses in QuantChain; mutated directly in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private owner address assigned msg.sender in the constructor and used for privileged authorization.
Total token supply set from the constructor argument.
Constant router address granted unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by ensure modifier; adjusts allowance and balances without SafeMath.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Owner-only function performing arbitrary delegatecall to user-supplied address a.
Owner-only batch transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length and looping unchecked balance additions.
Internal pure function deriving a Uniswap pair address from factory, token ordering and init code hash.
Modifier computing the UNI pair and requiring _from or _to to be owner or the computed pair.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, allowance keys and balance mutation.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an attacker-influenced address inside delegate().
Unchecked balanceOf +=/-= arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend enabling overflow/underflow.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check in delegate and batchSend.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter used in transfer, transferFrom and batchSend arithmetic.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend.
Loop index iterating over recipients in batchSend.
Local pair address computed by pairFor inside the ensure modifier.
Returned pair address computed by keccak256 in pairFor.
Lower-ordered token address selected in pairFor.
Higher-ordered token address selected in pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer delegates its entire logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used for allowance lookup and the spender identity in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key when writing allowance in approve.
msg.sender is compared against owner before the delegatecall in delegate.
msg.sender is used both for the owner check and as the balance source in batchSend.
msg.sender drives the require(msg.sender == owner) authorization decision.
The owner equality check gates whether delegate executes its delegatecall.
The owner equality check gates execution of batchSend.
User-supplied address a and bytes b flow directly into the delegatecall operation.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked -= and += operations.
batchSend mutates balanceOf in a loop without SafeMath.
The _value amount feeds unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length can overflow before balances are adjusted.
Loop index drives repeated unchecked balance increments in batchSend.
_to is the destination address forwarded by transfer.
_from is the debited source address in transferFrom.
The ensure modifier restricts which _from/_to pairs transferFrom accepts.
The ensure modifier invokes pairFor to compute the allowed pool address.
pairFor's return value is stored in the local UNI variable inside ensure.
The computed UNI pair address is compared against _from and _to in transferFrom's guard.
local_pair is the assembled keccak256 address returned by pairFor.
local_token0 is an ordering input to the pair hash in pairFor.
local_token1 is an ordering input to the pair hash in pairFor.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a plain parameter consumed only by the transfer function and can be folded into it.
_value is the amount operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic operation.
_from is a plain parameter used only inside transferFrom.
total is a purely local intermediate feeding the unchecked multiplication/balance updates.
The loop counter only drives the unchecked balance increments in batchSend.
local_UNI is a temporary result of pairFor used solely within the ensure modifier.
local_pair is the return value of pairFor and carries no independent state.
token0 is a sorting temporary inside pairFor.
token1 is a sorting temporary inside pairFor.
